name: IGNATIUS FRAME
walkToNote: Thad is where he stood to ask; he turns to him.
note: IGNATIUS FRAME, stood back from his press with the funeral notice set (doc 118 O-2, errata 253): the same man, by his back editions with his arms folded, so that the press is Thad's to pull. He walks here from the press when his lines are over (`arrive`), and is here while the notice is set or wet in Thad's hand. reference/press-pull: operations 4 (the walk, six frames) and 2 (stood back).
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Frame.

sprite.frameNote: 0 stood back, three-quarter to the press, arms folded with his notebook under them · 1 breath (derived) · 2 taking a note, the pencil from behind his ear (frame 3 of his own sheet, on this sheet's sole row: tools/art/press-pull-stood-sheet.py). Breathing on 0 and 1; every `breakEvery` seconds the note (errata 77).

arrive.note: From his press, where `frame` stood until this moment, to his back editions: six frames of one full cycle, facing left (press-pull operation 4; reference/press-walk-six). After the lines that sent him, so he says his piece at the press and then steps away.
